level_one.title: Increasing Clarity
level_one.description: Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.

level_four.title: Majestic Span
level_four.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

level_seven.title: Energized Cord
level_seven.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 130% of the damage against Heroes and 70% of the damage against non-Heroes.  Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.  Passive: Increase Basic Attack Range by 1.1.

level_ten.title: Resurrect
level_ten.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.  Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

level_thirteen.title: Converging Force
level_thirteen.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

level_sixteen.title: Reservoir of Hope
level_sixteen.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.

level_one.title: Unrelenting Torment
level_one.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Festering Wounds
level_seven.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

level_ten.title: Wailing Arrow
level_ten.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

level_thirteen.title: Windrunner
level_thirteen.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 4 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

level_sixteen.title: Evasive Fire
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

level_one.title: Third Wind
level_one.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 (+4% per level) per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 (+4% per level) per second Restoration.

level_four.title: Thunder Burn
level_four.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second Thunder Clap explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 72 (+4% per level) damage.

level_seven.title: Skullcracker
level_seven.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same enemy deals 90% bonus damage and Stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

level_ten.title: Avatar
level_ten.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Bronzebeard Rage
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Stoneform
level_sixteen.description: Activate to heal Muradin for 30% of his maximum Health over 10 seconds. Second Wind is disabled during this time.

level_one.title: Lion's Maw
level_one.description: Quest: Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Taunt
level_four.description: Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.  Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

level_seven.title: Second Wind
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.

level_ten.title: Warbringer
level_ten.description: Reduce Charge's cooldown by 8 seconds and Mana cost from 45 to 25. Additionally, Charge can be cast on allied Heroes.

level_thirteen.title: Juggernaut
level_thirteen.description: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.

level_sixteen.title: Banner of Dalaran
level_sixteen.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20% increased Spell Power to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

level_one.title: Boneslicer
level_one.description: Grievous Throw now pierces through all enemies hit and restores 15 Mana per Hero hit. Additionally, Grievous Throw's mark is no longer removed by Basic Attacks.

level_four.title: Troll's Blood
level_four.description: Increase Regeneration's healing by 25%. If Regeneration fully finishes, restore 10% of Zul'jin's maximum Mana.

level_seven.title: Vicious Assault
level_seven.description: Increase the duration of Grievous Throw's mark by 3 seconds and its damage bonus by 45%.

level_ten.title: Taz'dingo!
level_ten.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

level_thirteen.title: Ensnare
level_thirteen.description: Throw a net forward, Rooting the first enemy Hero hit for 1.5 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, Ensnare's cooldown is reduced to 10 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: No Mercy!
level_sixteen.description: Zul'jin's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes marked with Grievous Throw ignore Armor and deal an additional 2% of maximum Health as damage.

level_one.title: Hyper Shift
level_one.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Critical Mist
level_seven.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

level_ten.title: Blink Heal
level_ten.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Safety Dust
level_thirteen.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

level_sixteen.title: Critterize
level_sixteen.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level_one.title: Adrenaline Stimpack
level_one.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

level_four.title: Incinerator Gauntlets
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

level_seven.title: Nanomachine Coating
level_seven.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 35% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Bunker Drop
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

level_thirteen.title: Collision Course
level_thirteen.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Protection
level_sixteen.description: Each enemy hit by Jet Propulsion grants 10 Armor for 3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: Master Assassin
level_four.description: Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%.  Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

level_seven.title: Melting Point
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Commandeer Odin
level_ten.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spray 'n' Pray
level_thirteen.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

level_sixteen.title: Armor Piercing Rounds
level_sixteen.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

level_one.title: Aether Walker
level_one.description: Teleport costs no Mana. If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds. Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

level_four.title: Triumvirate
level_four.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

level_seven.title: Calamity
level_seven.description: Teleport does 300 (+3% per level) damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

level_ten.title: Wave Of Force
level_ten.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Illusionist
level_thirteen.description: If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.  This effect has a 4 second cooldown.  Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

level_sixteen.title: Mirrorball
level_sixteen.description: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

level_one.title: Legion of Beetles
level_one.description: Beetles have 30 Spell Armor. Automatically spawn a Beetle every 12 seconds. Can be toggled on and off.

level_four.title: Bed of Barbs
level_four.description: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that Slows enemies by 25% and deals 21 (+4% per level) damage per second. Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Leeching Scarabs
level_seven.description: Beetles attacks deal 30% more damage and heal Anub'arak 50% of damage dealt if he is nearby.

level_ten.title: Cocoon
level_ten.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

level_thirteen.title: Burning Beetles
level_thirteen.description: Deal 21 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

level_sixteen.title: Epicenter
level_sixteen.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.
